# Python Collections 🧰

## deque (Double-ended queue)

```python
from collections import deque

d = deque([1, 2, 3])
d.appendleft(0)  # O(1)
d.popleft()       # O(1)
```

## Counter

```python
from collections import Counter

c = Counter('abracadabra')
print(c)  # Counter({'a': 5, 'b': 2, 'r': 2, ...})
print(c.most_common(2))  # [('a', 5), ('b', 2)]
```

## defaultdict

```python
from collections import defaultdict

d = defaultdict(list)
d['key'].append(1)  # No KeyError!
```

slides.title: Heapq Module
slides.content:
# Heap Operations 🏔️

## Priority Queue

```python
import heapq

heap = []
heapq.heappush(heap, 3)
heapq.heappush(heap, 1)
heapq.heappush(heap, 2)

heapq.heappop(heap)  # Returns 1 (smallest)
```

## Useful Functions

```python
nums = [3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9]

heapq.nsmallest(3, nums)  # [1, 1, 3]
heapq.nlargest(3, nums)   # [9, 5, 4]

heapq.heapify(nums)  # Convert list to heap O(n)
```

> 💡 **Python heaps are min-heaps!** For max-heap, negate values.

# Itertools ♾️

## Combinations & Permutations

```python
from itertools import combinations, permutations

list(combinations([1,2,3], 2))  # [(1,2), (1,3), (2,3)]
list(permutations([1,2,3], 2))  # [(1,2), (1,3), (2,1), ...]
```

## Other Useful Functions

```python
from itertools import chain, groupby, accumulate

# Chain iterables
list(chain([1,2], [3,4]))  # [1, 2, 3, 4]

# Cumulative sum
list(accumulate([1,2,3,4]))  # [1, 3, 6, 10]
```
